title: Nishpaksh: TEC Standard-Compliant Framework for Fairness Auditing and Certification of AI Models
reasoning: The paper presents a technical framework for auditing and certifying AI models based on a national regulatory standard (TEC). It focuses on statistical fairness metrics and demographic bias detection (e.g., race and gender) within general AI and telecom applications, rather than evaluating or benchmarking moral reasoning, religious belief systems, or philosophical ethical frameworks.
